comments.content: This argument is a no-op write: `app` is the same row instance read at the top of `onPackageInstalled` (`repo.getAppByPackage(packageName)`), so passing `app.installedVersion` simply rewrites the tag column with the value it already holds. Preserving the tag is the intended "observe zone" behaviour (as documented in `InstalledAppUpdates.kt` and implemented by `SyncInstalledAppsUseCase.syncVersion` via `observeExternalInstall(...) + updateApp(...)`), but expressing it as a write of the row's own value is implicit and fragile: if the row is mutated between the read and this call (e.g. a concurrent install confirmation), this write would silently roll the tag back to the stale value. Prefer an observe-specific repository/DAO path that does not include `installedVersion` in the UPDATE, so the "external observations never touch the tag" invariant is enforced rather than implied.
